meta.title: Lucia Adams · Custom webs and systems
meta.description: Custom web development for businesses: catalogs, automation and internal systems that make your website run itself.

home.headline2: I build the systems that make them work.
home.sub: Custom builds for businesses that need more than a good-looking page: catalogs, sales flows, automation.

notes.label: No templates
notes.body: Every project is drawn from scratch around how your business works, not the other way around.

notes.label: Systems first
notes.body: Before designing screens, I map processes: what you sell, how you manage it, what can be automated.

notes.label: Marketing built in
notes.body: I come from digital marketing. I know how people behave and design for that, not just for looks.

work.intro: Three projects in production. Each drawing has two layers: the surface you see and the system driving it.

pulpina.name: PULPIÑA RD
pulpina.alt: Pulpiña RD home page with its three stores: Moon, Sunshine and Men

surface.label: Three universes, one brand
surface.body: Moon, Sunshine and Men: each line with its own palette, mascot and storefront.

surface.label: Custom illustration and branding
surface.body: A full identity drawn for the store, from the logo to each universe's badges.

surface.label: Own UI, zero template
surface.body: Typography, color and components built around the brand's personality.

systems.label: Catalog by universe
systems.body: One inventory, three storefronts: each product is tagged once and shows up where it belongs.

systems.label: WhatsApp ordering
systems.body: The cart builds the order and hands it off where people already buy: WhatsApp, with an order number.

systems.label: Automated offers
systems.body: New and Sale badges plus birthday discounts driven by rules, not by hand.

stemise.name: STEMISE
stemise.alt: STEMise home page with its headline, navigation and calls to action

surface.label: Clear, friendly brand
surface.body: A simple visual system that works the same for students across 30+ countries.

surface.label: Goal-based navigation
surface.body: Kits, curriculum, volunteering and donations: every visitor finds their path in one click.

surface.label: Actions with hierarchy
surface.body: Two clear calls on the home page: get kits or see the curriculum. Nothing competes with that.

systems.label: 501(c)(3) donations
systems.body: A donation channel fiscally sponsored by Hack Club, ready to receive funds from day one.

systems.label: Kit distribution
systems.body: The request and delivery flow behind 150+ STEM kits donated to students.

systems.label: Open curriculum by age
systems.body: Content organized by primary, middle and high school, maintained as an open resource.

togethersport.name: TOGETHER SPORTS
togethersport.alt: Together Sports home page with its motto Play Loud. Build Strong. and program photos

surface.label: An identity that shouts the motto
surface.body: Play Loud. Build Strong. carried into giant type, color and rhythm.

surface.label: Real photography
surface.body: Photos from the programs, not stock: the site feels like the practices do.

surface.label: Color per sport
surface.body: Each program with its own color and graphics, held together under one brand.

systems.label: Multi-program architecture
systems.body: Tennis, basketball, football and golf: each sport gets its own section without duplicating the site.

systems.label: Participation paths
systems.body: Donate, volunteer or sign up: every visitor leaves the home page with a next step.

systems.label: Second Serve
systems.body: A used-equipment donation flow with partner Rally Forward NYC, back into the community.

steps.body: The business first: what you sell, how you work and what eats your time.
An interface that feels like yours, not pulled from a template catalog.
Custom code, made to grow without breaking.
We iterate until what you see convinces you and what you don't see runs on its own.

panel.title: Start a project
panel.body: Tell me what your business does and what it needs: I'll draft the blueprint.
